text: Several slang terms have been adopted on Drag Race; some were already present in drag culture but gained broader popularity through the show’s various seasons, while others originated within the Drag Race franchise. During his 2018 appearance on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, RuPaul explained some of the show’s terminology to host Stephen Colbert.[1] Among the slang terms used on the series is one that describes when a drag queen appears to look like a cisgender woman.
